solution:
Since $\sec\theta=\tfrac1{\cos\theta}$,
$$2\cos\theta=\frac{1}{\cos\theta}\quad\Rightarrow\quad 2\cos^{2}\theta=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad \cos^{2}\theta=\tfrac12.$$
Thus $\cos\theta=\pm\tfrac{1}{\sqrt2}$. The solutions in the given range are
$$\theta=45^{\circ},\,135^{\circ},\,225^{\circ},\,315^{\circ}.$$
(We must have $\cos\theta\ne0$, which is satisfied.)
